items.text:
So far, from the little I've seen, I foresaw tones of engaging depths but unintuitiveness, inaccessibility, and clunkiness at its core.
And I don't think time alone can fix this, give or take.
items.text_zh:
到目前为止，从我看到的少量内容来看，我预见到了引人入胜的深度基调，但其核心却是缺乏直觉性、难以接近和笨重。
而且我认为仅靠时间无法解决这个问题，或多或少。

observations.evidence: unintuitiveness, inaccessibility, and clunkiness at its core
observations.evidence_zh: 其核心是不直观、难以接近和笨拙
